search_design: Purposive bounded primary-publisher/PubMed/author-repository starting search, not systematic review.
screening_depth: Bibliographic/abstract or selected-section review; exact full-text option appraisal pending.

families.screened_evidence: **M consensus:** Keil et al. 2014, [EEG/MEG publication guidelines](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/psyp.12147). **M/V methods evaluation, separate team:** Widmann, Schröger & Maess 2015, [Digital filter design for electrophysiological data](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25128257/).
families.remaining_work: Link acquisition/reference, filter, rejection, epochs, electrodes and amplitude/peak windows individually. Numerical synthetic ERP agreement is not empirical component/consumer validity. Use the consumer sources below only for scoped marketing hypotheses.

sources.label: Digital filter design for electrophysiological data

families.screened_evidence: **M consensus:** Keil et al. 2022, [Frequency and time-frequency analysis recommendations](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35398913/). **M review, independent team:** Norcia et al. 2015, [SSVEP paradigms and analysis](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26024451/). Widmann 2015 additionally informs filtering.
families.remaining_work: Welch bands/denominator, Morlet cycles/total-vs-induced/baseline transforms, SSVEP harmonics/taper/noise bins need direct option-level evidence. Two Keil committee papers are not independent replication. No universal theta/alpha/engagement or purchase-intent mapping.

families.screened_evidence: **M consensus:** Boucsein et al. 2012, [Publication recommendations for electrodermal measurements](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22680988/). **M/V original methods, distinct teams:** Benedek & Kaernbach 2010, [Continuous phasic EDA measure](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20451556/); Greco et al. 2016, [cvxEDA convex-optimization method](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26336110/).
families.remaining_work: Deconvolution papers do not validate Brohn's high-pass detector. Review each decomposition, cleaning cutoff, amplitude/prominence threshold, response selection/window, overlap and edge policy. Preserve exact-constant descriptive-only support. Arousal-related measurement does not establish emotion valence or liking.

families.screened_evidence: **M consensus:** Dunn et al., [Minimal reporting guideline, 2023 edition](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37507649/) (published online 2023; journal issue 2024). **M/V methodological threats, separate team:** Orquin & Holmqvist 2018, [Threats to validity of eye-movement research](https://pure.au.dk/portal/en/publications/threats-to-the-validity-of-eye-movement-research-in-psychology/).
families.remaining_work: Need annotated independent detector/device agreement for the adjacent-ray I-VT draft, including sampling/geometry/gaps/thresholds. Reporting compliance alone is not that agreement. Eye location, fixation candidates and visual attention/consumer preference need distinct claims.

sources.label: Threats to validity of eye-movement research

families.screened_evidence: **M/V:** Mathôt et al. 2018, [Safe preprocessing and baseline correction](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29330763/). **M methods guidance, separate team:** Kret & Sjak-Shie 2019, [Preprocessing pupil size data](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29992408/). **M contemporary methods context:** Mathôt & Vilotijević 2023, [Design, preprocessing and statistics](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36028608/).
families.remaining_work: Explicitly review luminance and gaze-angle confounds, positive-value/diameter-area units, external blink labels/edges, baseline support and missingness. Mathôt papers share authorship; do not count them as independent validation. The eye-tracking reporting guideline explicitly excludes incidental pupil/blink measurements from its scope.

families.screened_evidence: **M current committee guidance:** Quigley et al. 2024, [Publication guidelines, Part 1](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38873876/). **M independent recommendations:** Laborde, Mosley & Thayer 2017, [Experiment planning, analysis and reporting](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5316555/).
families.remaining_work: ECG peak detection and RR arithmetic do not establish NN intervals. Review ectopy/artifacts, duration, respiration/posture/activity, feature definitions, PSD interpolation/windows/bands and intended estimand. Neither guideline validates current interval filtering or licenses a stress score.

families.screened_evidence: **M literature map:** Mejía-Mejía et al. 2020, [PRV and its relationship with HRV](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32498055/). **V primary experiment:** same group 2020, [HRV/PRV responses to cold exposure](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32792970/). **M/V independent perspective:** Yuda et al. 2020, [PRV as a distinct biomarker](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32811571/).
families.remaining_work: The first two are not independent teams. Both the distinction and transfer need direct simultaneous-reference studies for target hardware, placement, motion and consumer context. Current named PRV cannot be relabelled HRV. Broader 2025 clinical study located but full appraisal not completed; not used to qualify options here.

sources.label: PRV and its relationship with HRV

families.screened_evidence: **M/V measurement systematic review:** MacRae et al. 2018, [Contact-thermometry setup variables](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29441024/). **V primary experiment, independent team:** Vinkers et al. 2013, [Site-dependent temperature changes under controlled stress](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23790072/).
families.remaining_work: Contact type/pressure/site, environment, settling and sensor calibration need explicit records and suitable reference tests. Stress-task/site findings do not validate a consumer stimulus, thermal imaging transfer or universal change direction. Operational threshold excursions and slopes need separate rationale.

sources.label: Site-dependent temperature changes under controlled stress

families.screened_evidence: **M/V primary detector study:** Khodadad et al. 2018, [Optimized breath detection in electrical impedance tomography](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30074906/). **M measurement review, independent team:** Massaroni et al. 2019, [Contact-based respiratory-rate methods](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6413190/).
families.remaining_work: Establish transfer from EIT to each admitted belt-displacement/lung-volume source; independently review inspiration polarity, cycle boundaries and known labels. Belt amplitude is not calibrated volume; airflow is a different signal. Consumer relevance and physiological coupling require further studies, not an engine citation.

sources.label: Optimized breath detection in electrical impedance tomography

families.screened_evidence: **M guidance:** Fridlund & Cacioppo 1986, [Human EMG research guidelines](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3809364/) (bibliographic screening; full-text appraisal needed). **M/V independent consensus/evaluation:** Hermens et al. 2000, [SEMG sensors and placement recommendations](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11018445/).
families.remaining_work: Current generic surface EMG needs muscle-specific montage/filter/envelope/threshold validation. Facial/startle/MVC normalization are separate procedures. Startle consensus DOI10.1111/j.1469-8986.2005.00271.x is an existing pointer requiring its own full review, not admission by generic EMG.

families.screened_evidence: **M/V primary methods experiment:** van Hees et al. 2013, [Movement/gravity separation and ENMO](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23626718/). **M independent measurement recommendations:** Düking et al. 2018, [Reliability, sensitivity and validity of wearable sensors](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29712629/).
families.remaining_work: Need device/placement/rotation validation, calibration, gravity and negative-ENMO policy review. Physical-activity findings do not establish motor approach, psychological arousal, posture or consumer attention.

sources.label: Reliability, sensitivity and validity of wearable sensors

families.screened_evidence: **M/V original toolbox/benchmark:** Cheong et al. 2023, [Py-Feat](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38156250/). **M interpretive review, independent team:** Barrett et al. 2019, [Challenges inferring emotion from facial movements](https://www.stacymarsella.org/publications/abstracts/barrett2019emotional-abstract.html).
families.remaining_work: Exact pinned Detectorv1 v2.0.0/model weights/threshold/stride need model-specific validation and population/context checks. Review source training labels separately from experienced emotion. Geometry, blendshapes, action units, category outputs, attention and liking are distinct variables. No automatic emotion/attention inference.

sources.label: Challenges inferring emotion from facial movements

families.screened_evidence: **V primary experiments:** Van der Cruyssen et al. 2024, [Online webcam eye-tracking replications of cascade, novelty and visual-world effects](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11289066/). **V independent multi-lab study:** Steffan et al. 2024, [Remote WebGazer in early childhood](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37850726/).
families.remaining_work: These support feasibility within tested tasks, including quality/exclusion limitations; they do not qualify Brohn's geometry provider or arbitrary adult consumer AOIs. Need exact provider, calibration/validation, drift, spatial/temporal precision, dropout and large/small-AOI applicability. The child study is not evidence for adult population equivalence.

sources.label: Online webcam eye-tracking replications of cascade, novelty and visual-world effects

families.screened_evidence: **M/V original task study:** Deary, Liewald & Nissan 2011, [Simple/four-choice RT task](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21287123/). **V independent hardware timing study:** Anwyl-Irvine et al. 2021, [Platforms, browsers and devices](https://link.springer.com/article/10.3758/s13428-020-01501-5). **V reliability study:** Hedge et al., [Reliability paradox](https://link.springer.com/article/10.3758/s13428-017-0935-1) (online 2017; issue 2018).
families.remaining_work: Need exact Brohn browser delivery/response timing, trial counts and reliability. Robust average task effects do not imply reliable individual differences. RT is not automatically attention, cognition, liking or a normative classification.

families.screened_evidence: **M/V scoring:** Greenwald, Nosek & Banaji 2003, [IAT improved algorithm](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12916565/); Nosek et al. 2014, [BIAT scoring studies](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0110938). **M current guidance:** Greenwald et al. 2022, [IAT best research practices](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34519017/). **V comparative methods study:** Bar-Anan & Nosek 2014, [Seven indirect attitude measures](https://link.springer.com/article/10.3758/s13428-013-0410-6).
families.remaining_work: These have substantial author overlap; an independent replication for each exact consumer profile is still needed. Bind D variant, error handling, exclusions/order, familiarity/materials and reliability. Do not infer a universal individual hidden preference or make all implicit tasks inherit IAT trimming.

families.screened_evidence: **V original multiverse/simulation analysis:** Kahveci et al., [Preprocessing decisions across six datasets](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10990989/) (online 2023; issue 2024). **V empirical different implementation, overlapping authors:** van Alebeek, Kahveci & Blechert 2021 (version 3), [Touchscreen food AAT and block-order validity](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10445824/).
families.remaining_work: The first two sources share authors and are not independent validation. An independent methods comparison is [Krieglmeyer & Deutsch 2010](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/02699930903047298), but it also tests different input representations; none validates the exact Brohn keyboard procedure. Independent exact keyboard-procedure consumer validation remains open. Error/outlier/difference scoring, stimulus relevance and assessment-vs-training require separate bindings.

sources.label: Touchscreen food AAT and block-order validity

families.screened_evidence: **M/V primary SC-IAT study:** Karpinski & Steinman 2006, [Single-category IAT](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16834477/), including a soda-brand domain. **M/V primary GNAT:** Nosek & Banaji 2001, [Go/No-Go Association Task](https://banaji.sites.fas.harvard.edu/research/publications/articles/2001_Nosek_SC.pdf). Bar-Anan & Nosek 2014 adds cross-method comparison.
families.remaining_work: Distinct tasks, not two independent validators of either profile. Brohn SC response-window variant, GNAT deadlines/quotas/extreme-rate correction and consumer stimulus context each need exact evidence. The 2007 proceedings source pointer is insufficient by itself.

families.screened_evidence: **V comparative start:** Bar-Anan & Nosek 2014 covers multiple indirect tasks. **V caution about task reliability:** Hedge et al. 2018. **V AMP-specific primary study:** Blaison et al. 2012, [AMP affective/nonaffective mechanisms](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22390705/).
families.remaining_work: AMP, priming, Stroop/flanker, stop-signal, VAAST/manikin, relational/agile tasks and learning/memory need individual primary specification plus independent validation and consumer relevance review. This is a discovery backlog, not academic coverage of each proposed method. Vendor manuals are not substitutes.

families.screened_evidence: **M methods primer:** Boateng et al. 2018, [Developing and validating scales](https://doi.org/10.3389/fpubh.2018.00149). **M/V measurement-practice analysis, independent team:** Flake & Fried 2020, [Questionable measurement practices](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/2515245920952393).
families.remaining_work: Generic reverse/sum/mean/proration/conversion arithmetic needs exact instrument-key/missingness sources. Content/translation/administration/population validity and reliability cannot be supplied by these general references. A seven-point liking item is a declared item, not a validated multi-item construct.

families.screened_evidence: **M mathematical primary source:** Marley & Louviere 2005, [Probabilistic best/worst models](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0022249605000441). **V/C independent primary consumer study:** Jaeger et al. 2008, [Food preference BWS vs monadic ratings](https://researchprofiles.ku.dk/en/publications/best-worst-scaling-an-introduction-and-initial-comparison-with-mo/).
families.remaining_work: Bind paired-vs-marginal/sequential likelihood, design connectivity/coverage, task burden and missing-pair policy. Study-specific consumer comparison does not support generic market shares or individual utilities. Participant-aware uncertainty/HB/conjoint are unimplemented by the current object-case pack.

sources.label: Food preference BWS vs monadic ratings

families.screened_evidence: **M/V original methods study:** Hessels et al. 2016, [AOI problem and noise-robust solution](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5101255/) (online 2015). **M/V independent threats analysis:** Orquin & Holmqvist 2018, [Eye-movement validity threats](https://pure.au.dk/portal/en/publications/threats-to-the-validity-of-eye-movement-research-in-psychology/).
families.remaining_work: Review exact geometry, noise margin, area/position/content differences, overlap/censoring, denominator and revisions. Labels alone do not make AOIs comparable; neither paper validates every Brohn rectangular/dynamic policy.

families.screened_evidence: **M mathematical source:** Holm 1979, [Sequentially rejective multiple-test procedure](https://www.jstor.org/stable/4615733) (bibliographic verification; full derivation review pending). **M/V distinct estimand:** Bakdash & Marusich 2017, [Repeated-measures correlation](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5383908/). **M primary statistical design:** Westfall, Kenny & Judd 2014, [Participant and stimulus sampling](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25111580/).
families.remaining_work: These clarify separate decisions; they do not collectively validate the current entire pipeline. Match between/within-person estimands, repeated visits/stimuli, missingness and multiplicity. Current aggregation must not be presented as repeated-measures correlation. Crosswalk/clock integrity is not construct validity; prediction needs independent held-out evaluation.

families.screened_evidence: **M consensus:** Yücel et al. 2021, [Best practices for fNIRS publications](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7793571/). **M confound analysis:** Tachtsidis & Scholkmann 2016, [False positives and negatives](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4791590/).
families.remaining_work: Authors overlap with the consensus; seek independent sensor/pipeline reference validation. PPF, wavelengths/geometry, OD reference, coupling, systemic signals and motion choices need individual evidence. Current absence of motion/short-channel correction constrains interpretation; no full neural-activation claim.

families.screened_evidence: **M original software paper:** Jadoul, Thompson & de Boer 2018, [Parselmouth interface to Praat](https://researchportal.vub.be/nl/publications/introducing-parselmouth-a-python-interface-to-praat/). **V primary experiment, independent team:** Banse & Scherer 1996, [Acoustic profiles in vocal emotion expression](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8851745/).
families.remaining_work: The interface paper does not validate default pitch/frame settings. Experimental vocal-expression findings do not authorize inference of spontaneous consumer emotion from generic acoustic features. Need microphone/voice/language/noise, exact algorithm and naturalistic consumer validation.
